title: Spread rice and roll salmon sushi
task: making an inside-out style sushi roll with salmon and vegetables
setting: Overhead view of a white cutting board prep station. A plastic-wrapped bamboo sushi mat sits in the center. Nearby are a bowl of sushi rice, sheets of nori, raw salmon strips, tempura shrimp, shredded fish, and clear containers of sliced vegetables and greens, plus squeeze bottles of sauce. The cook wears clear food-service gloves throughout.

steps.text: Place and smooth the bamboo rolling mat
steps.detail: Gloved hands position a plastic-wrapped bamboo mat flat on the white prep board.
steps.expected: Correct: plastic-wrapped bamboo mat is properly positioned first on the prep board

steps.text: Scoop a handful of sushi rice
steps.detail: Both hands lift a clump of white rice from a green bowl.
steps.expected: Nori sheet must be placed on the mat BEFORE any rice is scooped; scooping rice now is out of order

steps.text: Spread the rice evenly over the nori
steps.detail: Rice is placed onto a nori sheet on the mat and pressed outward into a flat layer, leaving a bare strip of nori along the far edge.
steps.expected: For inside-out style the rice must cover the nori completely with no bare strip left; leaving a bare edge is the method for regular maki not uramaki, and the sheet must later be flipped

steps.text: Lay a strip of salmon on the rice
steps.detail: A piece of raw salmon is set horizontally across the rice near the near edge of the nori.
steps.expected: Fillings must not be placed on the rice; the rice-covered nori must first be flipped so nori is up, then salmon goes on the nori

steps.detail: The cook reaches to the ingredient containers and places green vegetable strips onto the rice beside the salmon.
steps.expected: Vegetable fillings are added only after the flip onto the exposed nori side beside the salmon; placing them on unflipped rice is incorrect for inside-out

steps.text: Roll the sushi tightly in the bamboo mat
steps.detail: Both hands lift the near edge of the mat and roll it forward over the fillings, pressing to form a tight cylinder.
steps.expected: Rolling can occur only after proper flip and fillings on nori; rolling rice-side-in with bare nori edge produces a standard roll not inside-out

steps.text: Set the finished roll aside and get fresh nori
steps.detail: The completed roll rests on the board while the cook reaches toward the upper shelf holding stacked nori sheets.
steps.expected: Correct to set the finished roll aside once formed, then retrieve fresh nori

steps.text: Start spreading rice on a new nori sheet
steps.detail: A fresh nori sheet is on the mat and hands begin placing and pressing a new layer of rice across it.
steps.expected: Correct to begin the next roll by placing fresh nori then spreading rice, but rice must again cover the entire sheet in preparation for flipping

afterClip: Finish spreading rice on the second nori, add fillings, and roll it
procedure: Position plastic-wrapped bamboo sushi mat flat on clean prep surface
Place nori sheet shiny-side down fully on the mat
Wet gloved hands, scoop sushi rice, and spread it in an even layer covering the ENTIRE nori with no bare strip
Optionally sprinkle sesame seeds on rice
Flip the rice-covered nori so rice faces down on the mat and nori faces up
Arrange salmon strips and vegetable fillings in a horizontal line across the nori (near edge)
Lift near edge of mat and roll forward tightly over fillings, pressing to form a compact cylinder with rice outside
Transfer finished roll off the mat to the side and repeat with fresh nori as needed
